title: HIWIN
description: hiwin.it zoominfo.com/c/hiwin-srl/446225948 HIWIN Italia is the Italian subsidiary of the global Taiwanese corporation HIWIN Technologies, a world leader in motion control and system technology. Founded in 2013 and based in the Milan area, the company specializes in manufacturing high-precision components such as ball screws, linear guideways, industrial robots, bearings, and drive systems. They serve a wide range of high-tech industries, including semiconductor, automation, and medical equipment sectors across Southern Europe.
